# Pods evicted due to node memory pressure

Random pods disappear and reschedule during busy periods; some requests fail during the shuffle.

Pods had no memory limits set, so a few noisy neighbors consumed node memory until kubelet triggered eviction of lower-priority pods (exit 137).

1. Identify the node under memory pressure and the top-consuming pods
2. Set requests and limits on the offending workloads
3. Add pod priority classes so critical pods survive eviction
4. Verify no further evictions during peak load

Error Details
```
Pod evicted: reason 'Evicted' message 'The node was low on resource: memory'; kubelet: attempting to reclaim memory; OOMKilled containers exit code 137
```

Tags: infra, kubernetes, eviction, exit-137, memory-pressure
